Not for Me. I found it to be decent, but struggled to nail down a few customizations that other apps have a more smooth UX/UI for. Below are my four struggles with this app, plus two positives. 
Struggles: 
1. Reminders/notifications. I wanted to add reminders to specific days, while keeping the habits available for all days. For example, I may want to receive a reminder to workout on Tuesday, but if I don’t go until Wednesday, I still want to mark it off. Essentially, I don’t love how task days and reminders are linked. 
2. Tracking completion. I also find tracking completion to be a little more confusing than it needs to be. While adding an amount is helpful for some habits, there are times when I want to simply want to check a box with the more detailed options hidden away. Additionally, looking back to see what I’ve logged, in case I’ve already tracked the habit for the day, isn’t the easiest to discern. Yes, I can just check them off from the main page, but the simple interface should be fluid throughout, even with the custom options provided. 
3. Previous completion via the main page. I don’t love looking back at completion on previous days on the main page. Seeing a highlighted task is great to tell which I’ve completed, but seeing 2/3 of my goal for the week doesn’t show if I completed 2 on that day, or just 1 to add to my progress of 2 for the week. Again, other apps have figured this out better. 
4. Widgets. Great visually, but using them is less than helpful for how I complete habits (a max of 1 count tracked per day, per habit). I want to clic to track a single completion/count, and instead, it completes the entire goal when I click on it. Not ideal for me. 
Positives:
1. Customization. I do appreciate the amount of customization available. While I still find some areas where customization options are missing (reminder days), I overall appreciate the amount of customization available in other areas. They are typically just not to the extent I need, but I’m sure are great for some users. 
2. Pricing. The amount of access at the free plan is great, and even if you do decide to get the premium plan, the price is very affordable compared to others.
